Age of artificial intelligence.
when I'm increasingly using
free open-source tools
because I can simply deploy them
for myself easily
with the help of AI agents
or just write the software
I need for work myself,
I thought,
“Why don't we return
to the roots,
to good old software
that you pay for once
and use for life?”
Yes, maybe it's not
as interesting from a business
point-of-view,
